cases.name: minimal
cases.why: Nothing read yet (an empty record).

cases.name: two_results
cases.why: A nine-hole tournament with its card and own place, an 18-hole one.

cases.name: everything
cases.why: Every optional part, a private round without a name, a no-show, a result before the WHS (points), an adjustment.

notice.message: Three scorecards come with the next read.

cases.name: page_history
cases.why: 1.10.0: one page of the History Sheet as the player opened it (a batch per page; the first result of a sequence of three that are one result).

generator.name: Golf Stats Sync for Chrome and Edge

cases.name: page_scoring
cases.why: 1.10.0: the same result from the Scoring Record, now with its Score Differential.

generator.name: Golf Stats Sync for Chrome and Edge

cases.name: page_own_place
cases.why: 1.10.0: the same result again with the player's own place from the result list (the whole result, so the target finds it).

generator.name: Golf Stats Sync for Chrome and Edge

cases.name: wrong_format
cases.why: Another format version.

cases.name: no_account_ref
cases.why: account_ref is required.

cases.name: no_sheet
cases.why: sheet is required.

cases.name: sheet_unknown
cases.why: sheet is a closed list.

cases.name: local_time
cases.why: Times carry their zone.

cases.name: day_as_german
cases.why: Days are YYYY-MM-DD.

cases.name: no_day
cases.why: A result has its day.

cases.name: nothing_tells_the_holes
cases.why: holes_read, par or cr: one of them.

cases.name: marker_name
cases.why: A registered private round never carries a name (it is the marker's).

cases.name: other_players
cases.why: No room for other players: only the own place and field.

cases.name: null_value
cases.why: Unknown values are left out, not null.

cases.name: sd_as_text
cases.why: Numbers are JSON numbers (the record's commas are the client's to read).

cases.name: index_out_of_range
cases.why: An index is between -10 and 54.

cases.name: index_without_day
cases.why: An index says the day it is for.

cases.name: card_of_ten
cases.why: A scorecard has 9 or 18 holes.

cases.name: hole_without_par
cases.why: Every hole has its par.

cases.name: too_many
cases.why: At most 500 results in a batch.

cases.name: unknown_top_level
cases.why: Extensions go into extra.

cases.name: notice_code
cases.why: Notice codes are a closed list.
